root.command: IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.ClientMailSendLogTbl', N'U') IS NULL BEGIN CREATE TABLE dbo.ClientMailSendLogTbl ( ClientMailSendLogID INT IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT PK_ClientMailSendLogTbl PRIMARY KEY, SentAt DATETIME NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_ClientMailSendLog_SentAt DEFAULT (GETDATE()), MessageName NVARCHAR(120) NULL, Subject NVARCHAR(300) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_ClientMailSendLog_Subject DEFAULT (N''), FilterText NVARCHAR(1000) NULL, EmailsSent INT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_ClientMailSendLog_Sent DEFAULT (0), EmailsFailed INT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_ClientMailSendLog_Failed DEFAULT (0), SentBy NVARCHAR(100) NULL ); END
